[Explore this instance](https://hodge.computer/#case/klein-coupled-character) · [Exact statement](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/blob/main/data/klein-coupled-character/instance.rec) · [Mathematical context](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/blob/main/data/klein-coupled-character/why.md)

This thread is shared with the website. To submit a proof for acceptance, follow the [contribution instructions](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and open a solution PR. A discussion comment does not replace a checked proof.

nodes.body:
Partial update for `klein-coupled-character`: the original $q=1$, $A=X_0^3Y_0^3$ target is unchanged, and **step 23 remains unsolved**.

Two construction families now have explicit obstructions:

1. On the source-adapted degree-21 support at $\epsilon=1$, the three fixed $t/r/s$ Hamiltonians, **individually balanced at the 13 ordinary residue orbits**, give distinct compact controls. Cofactor elimination forces the only possible rational base-amplitude candidate. After clearing its denominator, the necessary identity has residual $(39,22,26,84,83)\ne0$ modulo 101 at the specified good point. This excludes that three-control family even with arbitrary rational amplitude poles, retaining the amplitude-dependent fiber corrections. Pointwise first-jet surjectivity did not give a rational solution.

2. A **single normalized variable-trigonal trace**, with arbitrary rational $w(a,b)$ and one common seed, cannot produce the required boundary source $K_\eta$. On a proper resolution of the degree-seven density cover, every polar curve is rational except one deck-stable curve. The seven target norm-pole curves are Klein curves cyclically permuted by the deck action; properness, residues and equivariance give a contradiction. The weighted source is regular at infinity; that boundary was retained.

[Derivations, scripts, recorded outputs, reproduction commands and SHA-256 manifest](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/a66456607d1bb86dee4294fa2128f692/06d3d8e2bd59cb6496b1a31e9b9399fdebf82d0a).

These conclusions exclude only the stated families. Collective residue cancellation **before individual balancing**, independent seeds/weights, additional compact controls and fiber-dependent amplitudes remain open. No full original $D/N/Q$ certificate or Lean proof has been obtained.

AI-assisted research and update prepared with Codex/GPT-6 for `fqlx`; prior human references are credited in the packet. No additional mathematical replay was run solely for this post.

**Partial update (exclusions only, no certificate): every certificate denominator has degree $\ge 7$; degree 7 is closed in 13 of the 14 $\sigma$-eigen pure-parity sectors**

Prepared for `kejace` with Claude (Anthropic) assistance; no human review yet; nothing Lean-verified; no certificate claimed.

Target unchanged: $q=1$, $A=X_0^3Y_0^3$ on the coupled Klein sextic. $\sigma=\mathrm{diag}(\zeta,\zeta^2,\zeta^4,1,1,1)$, $\zeta^7=1$; "character" = $\sigma$-weight of $D$, "parity" = $Y$-parity. Normalized form (book ch. 1): $E_1$: $N(F)=AD$, $E_2$: $D\,\mathrm{div}N-N(D)\in(F)$; $E_1$ forces $AD\in J(F)$. "Proved" below means exact over $\mathbb Q$, or modular with an explicit transfer (projective emptiness mod $p$ transfers to $\bar{\mathbb Q}$; colon dimensions transfer because $J(F)$ is a complete intersection mod $p$, $\mathrm{vdim}=15625$ at $p=1000003$ and $10^9+9$). Every item was replayed by a referee pass with an independent builder at $p=10^9+9$ (exact where stated).

**1. $E_1$-admissibility.** $(J:A)_d=J_d$ for $d\le 8$ in all 14 (parity, character) sectors (both parities at $1000003$, $10^9+7$, $10^9+9$; earlier runs at $32003$ and $2^{31}-1$). So every admissible $D$ of degree $\le 8$ is $D=\sum_i w_iF_i$. Kernel of $[A]$ on $R_d$ at $d=9$: even $[2,3,3,2,10,1,3]$, odd $[0,5,0,0,9,6,4]$ (even part exactly 24 over $\mathbb Q$); $d=10$: even $[24,46,39,39,54,46,46]$, odd $[36,39,39,36,39,36,36]$ (upper bounds).

**2. Hessian relaxation.** For $D=\sum w_iF_i$ every $E_1$-solution is $N=Aw+K(p)$ ($p$ antisymmetric, Koszul), and $E_2$ modulo $J$ reads $w^{\mathsf T}\mathrm{Hess}(F)\,w\in(J:A)_{2d-6}$: a homogeneous quadratic system in the coefficients of $w$, invariant under the gauge $w\mapsto w+l\,z$ ($D\mapsto D+6lF$), which we fix.

**3. Theorem (proved): $\deg D\ge 7$ for every certificate denominator, any parity and any character mixture.** $d\le4$: $(J:A)_d=0$. $d=5$: the 21 second partials are linearly independent (exact rank 21), so $w=0$. $d=6$, $Y$-odd: the relaxation ideal is $\mathfrak m$-primary ($\mathrm{vdim}\,57$). $d=6$, $Y$-even and mixed: the relaxation variety is a single curve $C$ inside the weighted-Euler family $D_\lambda=\sum_i\lambda_iZ_iF_i$ (every other coordinate squares into the exact ideal over $\mathbb Q$); in the gauge $\lambda_0=0$, $C$ is the complete intersection of three explicit quadrics in $\mathbb P^4$ (degree 8, genus 5). Second stage: the constant left-kernel vectors of the Koszul-form $E_2$ system for $D_\lambda$ give 8 exact necessary quadrics in $\lambda$ whose zero set is exactly the gauge line $\lambda\propto(1,\dots,1)$ ($D=6F$); with $\lambda_0=0$ the ideal is $\mathfrak m$-primary ($\mathrm{vdim}\,13$). Hence no point of $C$ carries a certificate.

**4. Lemma (proved).** Every nonzero $l\in\mathrm{span}(X_0,X_1,X_2)\cup\mathrm{span}(Y_0,Y_1,Y_2)$ satisfies $(J:l)_6=J_6$ (quadratic syzygies of the restricted partials: module annihilator $(1)$ in every chart of $\mathbb P^2$, two primes). By $E_1$ no nonzero $(3,1)$-class is supported on $X\cap V(l)$; with the Gysin description of $N^1$ (ch. 3) and the prescribed-support theorem (ch. 1), $\mathrm{served}(l\,D)=\mathrm{served}(D)$: such linear factors can be stripped.

**5. Degree 7, $\sigma$-eigen $D$ of pure parity.** Relaxation empty (proved) for $Y$-even characters $0,3,5,6$ and $Y$-odd characters $1,\dots,6$. For $Y$-even characters $1,2,4$ the relaxation variety equals the lifted curve $X_j\cdot C$ exactly over $\mathbb Q$ (characteristic-0 Gröbner bases, replayed), and $X_jD_\lambda$ is excluded by 4 + 3; for characters $1,2$ the exact second-stage duals even make the reduced system $\mathfrak m$-primary mod $p$. $Y$-odd character $0$: the relaxation variety lies in $\mathrm{span}(Y)\cdot C$ **modulo $1000003$ only** (Gröbner basis of 6358 elements, dim 4); its leading ideal has multiplicity 72 against degree 24 for that family (same at $10^9+9$), so the Hilbert-function sandwich cannot transfer it, and the exact second-stage duals leave a degree-64 curve. **Hence: no $\sigma$-eigen pure-parity denominator of degree 7 in 13 of 14 sectors; the ($Y$-odd, character 0) sector is screened, not proved.**

**6. Fixed denominators (exact over $\mathbb Q$).** The six polars $F_i$ and all 36 products $Z_jF_i$ are inconsistent (rational duals, and an independent exact-rank replay), so no certificate has poles inside $V(Z_j)\cup V(F_i)$. `fqlx`'s degree-9 $\hat J$ exclusion (any power, any support inside $V(\hat J)$) was reproduced exactly by a parallel verification pass; 5 of the 8 rational degree-9 kernel representatives (characters $0,3,5$) are excluded exactly by single-monomial functionals; the remaining representatives and random combinations only modulo $p$.

**Not claimed.** Nothing about non-eigen or mixed-parity $D$ of degree 7 or 8 (the 60-unknown degree-7 relaxation and the degree-8 sectors are unfinished), nothing about $d\ge 9$ beyond the listed denominators, no nonconstructive statement, and no claim that no certificate exists. Modular results are screens: a failed search in one space is not a proof of nonexistence.

Credits: the thread's prior work is `fqlx`'s packet (the $\hat J$ exclusion is the only prior rigorous denominator exclusion); `benediamond`'s accepted `klein-rational` and `klein-hesse` solutions live in the $\sigma$-invariant sector and do not reach this character; the support arguments use the book's prescribed-support theorem and Gysin description (chapters 1 and 3, with Diamond's necessity argument cited there). AI-assisted (Claude); computations with python-flint 0.9, msolve 0.6.5, Singular 4.3.

Reproduction (scripts, Singular/msolve inputs, JSON receipts, log; referee replays with an independent builder under `referee/`, `README-referee.md`):
https://github.com/kejace/sextics/tree/ae801eced7598ae8eca9943b6d206e3bcb53ac82/research/results/klein-coupled-character/wave2-excl — notes: https://github.com/kejace/sextics/blob/ae801eced7598ae8eca9943b6d206e3bcb53ac82/research/notes/wave2-klein-coupled-character-excl.md

### The ordinary cubic-line correspondence has no required character

Prepared for `benediamond` with ChatGPT assistance. **This is a geometric exclusion, not an instance solve:** the fixed target remains $`q=1`$, $`A=X_0^3Y_0^3`$. The attachment contains written proofs, an independent boundary audit, exact inputs and replayable algebra checks; no Lean verification is claimed.

**Exact transfer.** Put $`(x,y,z)=(X_0,X_1,X_2)`$ and

```math
U=x^2y/z,\quad V=y^2z/x,\quad W=z^2x/y,\quad r=x^2/(yz),\qquad r^7=U^4W/V^5.
```

The coordinate Jacobian is $`14xyz`$, so the transported target density is $`rY_0^3/14`$. On an ordinary line $`(U,V,W,T)=(s,t,as+bt,cs+dt)`$ of the resulting cubic surface, the cyclic inverse image becomes the fixed genus-three curve $`C_0:u^7=v(v-1)^4`$ after adjoining $`\rho^7=b^5/a^4`$. Its holomorphic characters are $`1,2,4`$. Let $`S`$ be the actual cubic-line parameter surface, and $`S'`$ a smooth projective model of its Kummer cover. The needed character contribution would require a nontrivial-character holomorphic one-form on $`S'`$.

**The global calculation gives**

```math
H^{1,0}(S')_{\chi}=0\qquad(\chi\ne1).
```

Here is the structure of the proof. Every cubic surface contains the fixed infinity elliptic curve $`E:U^2W+V^2U+W^2V=0`$, giving $`S\to E`$. Its generic fiber is a smooth genus-31 weighted complete intersection; the projected-line incidence has generic degree 12. Exact algebra also excludes additional surface components mapping to a point of $`E`$. Coprimality of 12 and 7 then gives geometrically connected generic fiber for $`S'\to E`$.

At $`(1:0:0)\in E`$, the resolved cover has two positive-genus components, both genus-ten Fermat curves fixed pointwise by the deck group. **All other components are rational.** The boundary audit checks every endpoint and branch crossing, including exceptional divisors with valuation divisible by seven: their residual cyclic covers have exactly two branch points and are rational. Thus the nontrivial deck part of the Albanese map contracts the complete special fiber. Its pulled-back ample class has degree zero on every fiber; the map factors through the deck-fixed curve $`E`$ and is constant, proving the displayed vanishing.

This excludes the tested ordinary cubic-surface-line correspondence as a source of the required character. Other curves, correspondences and certificates remain open. The elliptic quotient alone would not prove this: positive-genus boundary components make the normalization calculation essential. Ambient Chern numbers likewise do not determine irregularity or its characters. This is the useful distinction between the incidence methods of [the Fano paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2512.07572v2) and the embedded-surface identity of [the Chern-number paper](https://arxiv.org/html/1610.04266v6).

[Proofs, exact inputs, two replay scripts and recorded outputs](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34291316/klein-line-character-proof.zip). The separate constructions and denominator exclusions of `fqlx` and `kejace` above retain their stated scopes.
